USAGE:
  sediment export [-h] <format> ...

  run an export projection

FORMATS:
  rlvr        export one explicit RLVR target
  dpo         dpo.jsonl — chosen/rejected pairs
  sft         sft.jsonl — supervised training targets
  diff-sft    diff_sft.jsonl — per-commit, per-file training rows
  recovery    recovery.jsonl — red-to-green CI-transition recovery pairs

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
